当你的应用需要构建基于知识库的智能问答系统时使用RAG能力
RAG的优势在于知识实时性（无需重新训练模型即可动态更新知识库）、可信度增强（生成内容基于检索结果，减少模型"幻觉"）和灵活适配（同一模型可快速切换不同领域知识库），适用于新闻、政策等高频变化领域
当你的应用需要高效的数据检索能力时使用智慧化数据检索，支持图片、文本等多种数据的融合查询，提供基于倒排检索和向量检索的多路召回与重排序
当你的应用需要数据不出端的智能问答能力时，可选择接入端侧问答模型，保障用户数据隐私安全
给应用接入本地知识库问答能力 / Integrate on-device knowledge base Q&A into the app
把业务文档切片并向量化后建立可检索知识库 / Chunk and embed business documents into a searchable knowledge base
实现基于向量召回和重排序的语义搜索 / Implement semantic search with vector retrieval and reranking
导入 PDF、Word、网页内容生成 RAG 检索数据 / Ingest PDFs, Word files, and web content to build RAG retrieval data
配置检索问答流程中的提示词模板和召回参数 / Configure prompt templates and retrieval parameters for the QA pipeline
让大模型回答时结合企业私有数据 / Ground LLM responses with private enterprise data
在端侧部署离线知识问答并保证数据不出设备 / Deploy offline on-device knowledge Q&A so data stays on the device
为客服助手接入多知识库切换和按领域检索 / Add multi-knowledge-base switching and domain-specific retrieval for a support assistant
实现上传资料后自动解析并同步到知识库 / Parse uploaded materials and sync them into the knowledge base automatically
对产品手册和 FAQ 建立向量索引供智能问答检索 / Build vector indexes for product manuals and FAQs for intelligent Q&A
集成混合检索能力同时支持关键词和语义召回 / Integrate hybrid retrieval supporting both keyword and semantic recall
管理知识库的数据导入、更新和增量构建 / Manage knowledge base ingestion, updates, and incremental indexing
do_not_use_when: 需求是做OCR文字识别、人脸检测/比对、主体分割、多目标识别或17点骨骼姿态分析，应改用 core-vision-kit / The requirement is OCR text recognition, face detection/comparison, subject segmentation, multi-object recognition, or 17-keypoint pose analysis; use core-vision-kit instead

需求是中英文分词、词性处理或抽取日期、地址、电话、邮箱等命名实体信息，应改用 natural-language-kit / The requirement is Chinese/English tokenization, lexical processing, or extracting named entities such as dates, addresses, phone numbers, and emails; use natural-language-kit instead

需求是拉起小艺开放平台智能体，或通过Function组件编排应用与智能体协同服务，应改用 agent-framework-kit / The requirement is to launch agents from the Xiaoyi Open Platform or orchestrate app-plus-agent services through Function components; use agent-framework-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已集成Data Augmentation Kit对应SDK，并且目标设备/系统版本支持该能力 / The project has integrated the Data Augmentation Kit SDK and the target device/system version supports this capability
若使用知识加工或检索问答，待处理数据源、知识库存储与相关服务在应用运行环境中可访问 / If using knowledge processing or retrieval QA, the data sources, knowledge base storage, and related services are reachable in the app runtime environment
若接入端侧问答模型，目标设备已具备可用的端侧模型资源与满足运行所需的算力/内存条件 / If using the on-device QA model, the target device has usable on-device model resources and sufficient compute/memory to run them
inputs: 用户问题或检索查询文本 / user question or retrieval query text
知识源数据（文本、办公文档、图片等） / knowledge source data (text, office documents, images, etc.)
知识库或索引标识 / knowledge base or index identifier
RAG配置参数（提示词模板、超参数、分析过程模板等） / RAG configuration parameters (prompt templates, hyperparameters, analysis-process templates, etc.)

postconditions.statement: 已在代码中接入Data Augmentation Kit相关API，用于知识加工、智慧检索、RAG问答或端侧问答之一 / The code integrates Data Augmentation Kit APIs for at least one of knowledge processing, intelligent retrieval, RAG QA, or on-device QA
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add or modify code/configuration that invokes Data Augmentation Kit capabilities for knowledge processing, intelligent retrieval, RAG question answering, or on-device question answering?

postconditions.statement: 若实现RAG流程，代码中已显式传入知识库/检索相关配置以及用户问题输入 / If a RAG flow is implemented, the code explicitly passes knowledge-base/retrieval-related configuration and the user question input
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the changes implement a RAG or retrieval-based QA flow, do they clearly include both the user's query input and knowledge-base or retrieval configuration in the invocation path?

postconditions.statement: 若实现知识加工，代码中已声明并处理至少一种支持的数据来源（文本、办公文件或图片）以生成知识库内容 / If knowledge processing is implemented, the code declares and handles at least one supported data source (text, office file, or image) to generate knowledge-base content
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the edits add knowledge processing, do they show at least one supported input type such as text, office documents, or images being processed into knowledge-base content?
